weather.note: ★ **今天（10/19，週一）台北、台南都是多雲到晴，白天熱、早晚涼，日夜溫差大。**北部白天高溫約 **31–32°C**；中南部（含台南）西半部普遍 **32–34°C**，中南部內陸更熱；全台夜間低溫約 **23–26°C**。降雨只有**東北部迎風面、台東、恆春半島零星短暫陣雨**，其餘各地可不必帶傘。⚠️ **空品**：新竹苗栗、中部、高屏為「橘色提醒」（對敏感族群不健康），午後臭氧易升高；北部、雲嘉南為普通，宜蘭、花東、馬祖良好。　★★ **今天這一區真正的重點不是今天的天氣，是這一週的颱風：強烈颱風「薔琵」（CHAMPI，2026 年第 29 號）。**10/18 20 時：**中心位於北緯 13.6 度、東經 141.5 度，恆春東南東方約 2,470 公里**，中心氣壓 **925 hPa**、近中心最大風速 **51 m/s**、瞬間最大陣風 **63 m/s**，以**時速約 22 公里向西北西**移動。氣象署研判**強度在 10/19–10/20（一、二）達到顛峰**，之後略減弱但抵台前仍可能維持強颱。　★ **氣象署未來 120 小時暴風侵襲率（10/19 發布）**：宜蘭 56%、花蓮 56%、基隆 55%、台北 55%、新北 54%、桃園 53%、綠島 50%、新竹市／新竹縣 49%、苗栗 47%、蘭嶼 46%、台東 45%、台中 44%、南投 44%、彰化 42%、雲林 41%、嘉義市 39%、嘉義縣 37%、連江 35%、屏東 35%、恆春 34%、**台南 33%**、**高雄 32%**、澎湖 25%、金門 16%。→ 一句話：**這是一個「北台灣風險明顯高於南台灣」的颱風**，北北基桃宜花全部破 50%，台南高雄只有三成出頭。　★ **逐日時程（以 10/19 氣象署與氣象專家說法為準，仍可能修正）**：**10/20（二）**東風偏弱，多雲到晴，基隆北海岸、東北部與東南部沿海及恆春有零星短暫陣雨；**10/21（三）–10/22（四）**東北季風南下，新竹以北、宜蘭、花東、恆春轉雨，北部高溫降到 **28–29°C**，**最快 10/21 晚間至 10/22 可能發布海上颱風警報**；**10/23（五）**颱風外圍環流接近，**北部、宜蘭、花蓮有顯著降雨，局部大雨甚至豪雨**；**10/24（六）**雨區擴大到中部以北與東部，北部、中北部、東半部有長時間強降雨；**10/25（日）**颱風逐漸遠離。　⚠️ **路徑仍有相當不確定性**：多數歐洲系集持續朝台灣方向西北西前進，但部分模式顯示提早北轉、從宜蘭外海掠過北部海面；也有模式不排除**在東半部登陸**。氣象專家表示仍需約兩天才能收斂。**最快陸上颱風警報時間點目前推估在 10/22（四）**。　★ **今天就該做的三件事**：①**週五、週六（10/23、10/24）的戶外行程先標為「可能取消」**，特別是北部與東部的活動、交通與球場；②**趁 10/20（二）天氣還好先把陽台、窗戶、排水孔整理掉**，不要等陸警那天搶；③**家事類待辦（洗衣服／倒垃圾）盡量集中在 10/20–10/21 完成**，因為 10/23 起晾衣與垃圾車都可能受影響。　★ 資料來源：中央氣象署（10/18 20 時颱風觀測、10/19 暴風侵襲率與逐日預報）、中央社、ETtoday、NOWnews。

items.en: Cost-of-living protests turn violent across France; Limoges town hall gutted by fire and its spire collapses
items.zh: **法國物價抗議轉激烈** —— 巴黎、里昂、馬賽曲發生破壞與搶掠，里昂觀光處遭纵火，歷史建築黎茂市政廳尖塔燒毀倒塌，Euronews 採訪團隊在巴黎遭攻擊與搶奪
items.summary: Demonstrations against the rising cost of living escalated into violence across France on October 18, with students joining marches in Paris, Lyon and Marseille. Shops were looted in Paris and Lyon, a tourism office in Lyon was set on fire, and the historic town hall in Limoges burned, its spire collapsing. Euronews said its own crew was attacked and robbed while covering the Paris protests. The unrest is part of a wider wave of cost-of-living and housing demonstrations spreading across Europe, with Portugal among the countries affected and anti-government protests in Albania entering a fifth day, where police fired rubber bullets and made hundreds of arrests.

items.en: Alberta votes Monday on whether to begin leaving Canada; separatist leader says movement continues either way
items.zh: **加拿大亞伯達今天（10/19）投票**決定是否啟動脇離加拿大程序，分離派團體 Let Alberta Decide 共同主席誧「不訖結果如何，我們已經赢了」
items.summary: Keith Wilson, co-chair of the pro-independence group Let Alberta Decide, told supporters at a rally outside the Alberta legislature that the movement will continue even if voters reject Monday's proposal to begin leaving Canada. "Regardless of what happens on Monday, we've already won," he said, arguing that turning separation into a major national political issue was itself the victory. The vote is the most concrete test yet of Alberta separatist sentiment, which has grown alongside disputes over federal energy and climate policy. A rejection would not end the campaign, according to organisers, who plan to keep pressing the question in provincial politics.

items.en: Pakistani and Afghan forces exchange artillery fire at several border points
items.zh: **巴基斯坦與阿富汗部隊 10/17（六）在多處邊境交火**，巴方宣稱以炮兵摧毀塔利班哨所、擊殺試圖由阿富汗東部湛入的巴基斯坦塔利班戰鬥人員
items.summary: Pakistani and Afghan forces exchanged fire at several locations along their shared border on Saturday, October 17. Pakistani officials and local media reported that artillery-backed troops destroyed Taliban posts along the north-western frontier. Officials also said troops killed an unspecified number of Pakistani Taliban militants who were attempting to cross from a remote area of eastern Afghanistan. Neither side published a verified casualty figure. The clashes mark a further deterioration in relations between Islamabad and the Taliban administration in Kabul, which Pakistan accuses of sheltering militants who stage attacks inside Pakistani territory, a charge Kabul rejects.

items.en: Kenya's Ebola outbreak reaches seven cases as three health workers test positive
items.zh: **肯亞伊波拉疫情增至 7 例** —— 3 名照護首例確診者的醫護人員確診，另一名隴離中的關係人也確診，4 名新病例已隴離治療
items.summary: Three Kenyan health workers tested positive for Ebola after caring for the country's first confirmed case, the Health Ministry said on Saturday, October 17. Another person linked to that case also tested positive while in quarantine, bringing Kenya's confirmed total to seven infections. The ministry said the four new patients have been placed in isolation and are receiving care, and that the other patients are in stable condition. Infections among health workers are a recognised early-outbreak risk and usually trigger a review of infection-control procedures and contact tracing. Kenya had not previously recorded a confirmed Ebola case.

items.en: Ukrainian drones strike St Petersburg oil terminal and industrial zone
items.zh: **烏克蘭無人機打擊聖彼得堡油品碼頭與工業區**，列寧格勒州升起濃煙與火光；同日川普簽署行政命令，豁免新一輮對俄制裁
items.summary: Smoke and flames rose over St Petersburg after drone attacks on an oil terminal and an industrial zone, which Ukrainian forces reportedly struck along with sites in the surrounding Leningrad region. The raids extend Kyiv's campaign against Russian energy infrastructure deep behind the front line. On the same day, US President Donald Trump signed an executive order waiving a new package of Russia sanctions, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, for C5+1 talks intended to strengthen Washington's ties with Central Asia. Taken together the three developments point to a widening gap between Ukrainian military pressure and US diplomatic posture.

items.en: Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its "biggest bet yet" on in-house AI silicon, claiming 40% more output per watt
items.zh: **微軟發表第三代自研 AI 晶片 Maia 300**（台積電代工），宣稱同等功耗下 AI 算力輸出多 **40%**、整櫃效能最高達現行世代 **7 倍**，2027 年起大規模部署
items.summary: Microsoft unveiled Maia 300, the third generation of its custom AI chip, designed in-house and manufactured by TSMC. The company says it delivers 40% more AI output for the same power as leading GPU-based systems, and that a full rack produces up to seven times the output of the current generation, targeting multistep AI agents and long-context models. Satya Nadella called it "our biggest bet yet on our own silicon"; Azure chief Scott Guthrie said Maia will become the primary inference system for Microsoft products. Large-scale deployment begins in 2027, and Evercore ISI estimates Maia will be about 10% of Microsoft's AI chip spending by early 2027 — so Nvidia and AMD stay dominant near term.
items.source: GeekWire（10/12 發表、本週持續發酯）；Yahoo Finance

items.en: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft's Ender Dragon in 27 hours for about $520 in API cost
items.zh: **Google DeepMind 課鶜：四個 Gemini 4 Argon 代理人在隨機生成的 Minecraft 世界裡花 27 小時 14 分鐘打敘終界龍**，按初始 API 定價估算單次成本約 **520 美元**（Easy 難度、單次實驗）
items.summary: A Google DeepMind paper reports that four Gemini 4 Argon agents working together defeated the Ender Dragon in a randomly generated Minecraft world in 27 hours and 14 minutes, a long-horizon benchmark that requires resource gathering, tool crafting, navigation and combat with no task-specific training. The paper estimates the run cost about $520 at Gemini 4 Argon's introductory API list price, and notes it describes a single run on Easy difficulty, so it is a demonstration rather than a measured success rate. Separately, Google Research says AI agents paired with wet-lab experiments raised confirmed on-target hit rates for designed DNA aptamers to 42.1% on one protein target.
items.source: FourWeekMBA AI Daily（10/17）轉述 Google DeepMind 與 Google Research 診文

items.en: OpenAI's $2.4bn 2026 ad revenue projection looks likely to fall short as it cuts prices to win advertisers
items.zh: **OpenAI 向投資人提出的 2026 年廣告收入 24 億美元目標，恐將未達標**；為拿下廣告主大幅降價，ChatGPT 廣告每次點擊約 **5 美元**，Google 同類客戶則要 **30–50 美元**
items.summary: The Information reports that OpenAI projected $2.4 billion of 2026 advertising revenue to investors and is now likely to fall short. OpenAI said on August 31, 2026 that its ad business had reached a $1 billion annualised run rate. According to the report, the company is cutting prices and hiring heavily from Meta to build out the business; one agency founder put ChatGPT ad pricing at roughly $5 per click, against $30 to $50 on Google for comparable clients. The gap cuts both ways: it is a strong pitch for advertisers testing the channel, but it means OpenAI needs far more volume to reach the same revenue, and it compresses the margin story investors were sold.
items.source: FourWeekMBA AI Daily（10/17）轉述 The Information

items.en: Dubois retains WBO heavyweight title, stopping Wardley inside two rounds in London
items.zh: **杜波易斯（Daniel Dubois）在倫敦兩回內 TKO 打敗 Fabio Wardley，術冠 WBO 重量級金腰帶**；Wardley 生涯首次被擊倒，就發生在開賽鐘後 30 秒內
items.summary: Daniel Dubois beat Fabio Wardley inside two rounds in London on Saturday night to keep his WBO heavyweight title. Wardley was knocked down for the first time in his career within 30 seconds of the opening bell and could not recover. The win is Dubois's second over Wardley in the same year: he took the belt in May by stopping him in the eleventh round, so the rematch produced a far more emphatic result than the first fight. On the undercard, unbeaten heavyweight Bakhodir Jalolov won a unanimous points decision over Solomon Dacres, keeping his record intact.

items.en: Rugby League World Cup opens: England's men lose 30-12 to Tonga while England's women thrash Wales 70-6
items.zh: **橄欖聯盟世界皯開賽**：英格蘭男隊以 **12–30** 不敬東加，斐濟 40–12 克克群島、巴布亞紐幾內亞 42–18 黎巴崩；女隊英格蘭 70–6 威爾斯、澳洲 40–0 薩摩亞
items.summary: The men's Rugby League World Cup opened with a heavy defeat for England, who lost 30-12 to Tonga. Fiji beat the Cook Islands 40-12 in Newcastle and Papua New Guinea beat Lebanon 42-18. In the women's tournament England opened with a 70-6 win over Wales, Australia shut out Samoa 40-0 and Papua New Guinea beat France 58-4; New Zealand also beat Fiji 18-12. The England men's result is the story of the weekend: Tonga have beaten them before but rarely by this margin, and it reframes the group as genuinely open rather than a procession for the hosts.

items.en: Buick lands a 206/1 treble at Ascot's Champions Day as O'Brien and Lordan win six of seven at Leopardstown
items.zh: **賽馬：William Buick 在亞斯科群雄日騎出 206/1 三連勝**（包含 Group 1 伊麗莎白二世賽與 Racing Stakes）；同日 Aidan O'Brien 與騎師 Wayne Lordan 在 Leopardstown **七場赢六場**
items.summary: William Buick rode a 206/1 treble at Ascot's Champions Day meeting on Saturday, winning the Group One Queen Elizabeth Stakes on Talk of New York, taking the Group One Racing Stakes with Ombudsman, and landing the Balmoral Handicap with 22/1 outsider Fifth Column. On the same afternoon in Ireland, trainer Aidan O'Brien and jockey Wayne Lordan combined to win six of the seven races at Leopardstown, a near-clean sweep of a card. Elsewhere in British sport, Mikaela Kartal beat Elina Svitolina to reach the Wuhan Open semi-finals, and former Sale lock Hyron Andrews died aged 31 after a fall.

items.en: 94% of Massachusetts teachers say anxiety and depression are problems for their students, first statewide survey finds
items.zh: **马薩諸塞州全州教師調查：94% 表示焦慮與憂鬱是學生的「問題或嚴重問題」**；貧窮（82%）、無家者（74%）、移民身分（70%）也被列為重大障礙
items.summary: Researchers at UMass Amherst's Center for Education Policy and the UMass Amherst Poll emailed surveys to about 18,000 Massachusetts public school teachers this summer; nearly 1,200 responded, weighted to reflect the workforce by gender, race, age, location and grade level. 94% said anxiety and depression are problems or major problems for their students. Teachers also cited poverty (82%), homelessness (74%) and immigration status (70%). Jack Schneider, who directs the centre, said teachers generally lack the time and training to address mental health needs; teachers called for higher pay, more counsellors and greater administrative support. The team hopes to run the survey annually.
items.source: WBUR（10/14 發布，本週持續被引用）

items.en: Yale finds cortisol rewires the brain to make emotional memories stronger and longer-lasting
items.zh: **耳魯大學：壓力荇爾蒙「皮质醬」會改寫大腦的編碼方式，把帶有情緒的經驗轉成更強、更持久的記憶**（對考試與報告前的練習策略有直接含意）
items.summary: Yale researchers reported on October 16 that cortisol, the body's main stress hormone, helps turn emotional experiences into stronger and longer-lasting memories by changing how the brain consolidates them. The finding gives a mechanism for a long-observed effect: moderately arousing or stressful material is remembered better than neutral material. For a student the practical reading is narrow but useful — mild pressure around the moment of learning, such as self-testing or a timed practice run, is doing something the brain is built to exploit, while sustained high stress is a different regime and is not what the study endorses. The work also bears on PTSD, where the same mechanism makes unwanted memories durable.

items.en: Deep sleep and growth hormone form a two-way loop that builds muscle, burns fat and supports the brain
items.zh: **深層睡眠與生長激素存在「雙向回路」**：大腦一邊調節身體修複（長肌肉、燃脂肪）、一邊調節清醒程度，睡眠品質直接影響隙天的認知表現
items.summary: A study reported on October 17 found a two-way link between deep sleep and growth hormone, showing how the brain balances physical recovery against wakefulness. Growth hormone release is concentrated in deep sleep and drives muscle repair and fat metabolism; the researchers found the relationship also runs the other way, with hormone signalling feeding back into sleep depth. The practical implication is that deep sleep is not a passive by-product of being tired but a regulated state that can be disrupted, and that losing it costs both physical recovery and next-day cognition. A separate ScienceDaily item this month reported that just 10 minutes of daily exercise measurably deepened sleep.

items.en: Anthropic reportedly offers Blackstone a 10% coupon on $9bn of junior debt inside a $60bn chip financing
items.zh: **Anthropic 「Project North Star」計畫：600 億美元晶片融資案中，向 Blackstone 提出 90 億美元次級債、票面利率高達 10%**；資金用來購置約 **1.5 GW** Google 開發的定制晶片
items.summary: The Financial Times reports that Anthropic offered Blackstone a 10% coupon on $9 billion of junior debt within a $60 billion chip financing called Project North Star, citing people familiar with the talks. Il Sole 24 Ore's account of the report says the money would fund roughly 1.5 gigawatts of custom chips developed by Google. For comparison, Anthropic raised about $4.4 billion in a similar deal, Project Big Sky, at 8.5% four months earlier — so the cost of capital for AI compute has risen sharply in a single quarter. Terms were still under negotiation. Separately, EverWind leased the first 95 MW phase of its Nova Scotia campus to an unnamed frontier AI developer for late 2027.
items.source: FourWeekMBA AI Daily（10/17）轉述 Financial Times、Il Sole 24 Ore

items.en: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falls 3.83% with all 30 members lower; memory and storage names hit hardest
items.zh: **半導體：10/16 費城半導體指數收 11,137.29、跌 3.83%，30 檔成分股全數下跌**；記憶體與儲存最差（Seagate -7.5%、WDC -6.86%、SanDisk -6.85%、SK Hynix -6.58%、Micron -5.63%）
items.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index closed at 11,137.29 on Friday, October 16, down 3.83%, with every one of its 30 constituents lower — a breadth reading that signals sector-wide de-risking rather than company-specific news. Memory and storage took the worst of it: Seagate -7.50%, Arm -6.94%, Western Digital -6.86%, SanDisk -6.85%, SK Hynix -6.58%. Logic and equipment followed: AMD -5.95%, Intel -5.79%, Micron -5.63%, Marvell -5.56%, KLA -5.00%. AI infrastructure name CoreWeave fell 11.91% to $61.39. This is the single most relevant data point for Monday's Taiwan open, because Taiwan's memory cluster (2408, 2344, 2337, 6770) had rallied into Friday's close.
items.source: TradingKey（10/16 美股收盤）；ABC News / AP

items.en: New York City awards $29.2m to NYU for a quantum chip fabrication facility, with NYU adding $255m
items.zh: **量子：紐約市政府 10/16 授與 NYU 2,920 萬美元建置量子晶片製造設施 QFab**（770 Broadway、2.3 萬平方英尺、2030 年啟用），NYU 再投 **2.55 億美元**做建置與十年運維
items.summary: New York City announced on October 16 that it is awarding $29.2 million to New York University for the Quantum Fabrication Facility (QFab), a 23,000-square-foot site at 770 Broadway due to open in 2030; NYU is adding $255 million for construction and ten years of operations. QFab will give researchers, students, startups and established companies access to equipment for building and testing quantum chips and devices, with workforce training through CUNY and city public schools. The city expects it to support more than 100 companies and reach 35,000 New Yorkers in a decade, and in a first-of-its-kind arrangement takes three advisory-board seats plus 15% of NYU's IP proceeds from city-funded tools.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's official ticket-exchange lottery closes within hours — the only hard追星 deadline today
items.zh: ⚠️ **Mrs. GREEN APPLE「Ringo Jam Tour "SHADOWS"」官方換票抽選 10/20（最晚 10/21）截止** —— 今天是最後穩得住的一天；下一站 **10/23–10/24 北海道真駒内**，全巡演 **沒有任何海外／亞洲场次**
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's fan-club arena tour Ringo Jam Tour "SHADOWS" began on September 30 and runs 28 shows across 14 two-night engagements in 13 Japanese locations, finishing December 27-28 in Aichi. The next stop is Makomanai in Hokkaido on October 23-24, and the official ticket-exchange lottery window closes on October 20, with October 21 the outer limit — making this the one time-critical item on the tracking list today. There are no overseas or Asian dates anywhere on the tour and Taiwan is not included; some applications are also restricted to Japan residents. Separately, the band's sixth album POPS, released September 30, has sold 602,000 copies and holds the top album spot.
items.source: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 官方（巡演與換票抽選）；Billboard JAPAN（POPS、「ア・ポステリオリ」MV）

items.en: Fujii Kaze opens his Prema World Tour at Kaohsiung National Stadium on Oct 31 — now 12 days away
items.zh: **藤井風 10/31（六）高雄國家體育場（世運主場館）** —— 距今 **12 天**、票已開賣，是《Prema World Tour》**全球首站**；★ 與 **Vaundy 台北小巨蛋首日（10/31）撒死撞期**，一南一北只能選一
items.summary: Fujii Kaze opens his Prema World Tour at Kaohsiung National Stadium on Saturday, October 31, twelve days from today, with tickets already on sale and capacity around 40,000. Kaohsiung is the global opening night of the tour, which then runs to Seoul in January 2027, with Europe and North America legs scheduled for summer 2027 and dates still TBA; the Bangkok show on December 26 and the Hong Kong date were cancelled. The scheduling conflict is the thing to decide now: Vaundy's first Taipei Arena night falls on the same October 31, at the opposite end of the island. Vaundy's second night, November 1, does not clash — so Kaohsiung on the 31st plus Taipei on the 1st is the only way to see both.
items.source: 藤井風官方／高雄市政府（場次與售票）；CDJapan J-POP Goes Global 2026

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu's GHOST world tour confirms two Taipei Dome nights on Dec 26-27 — his first career two-day dome run
items.zh: **米津玄師「KENSHI YONEZU 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR / GHOST」：12/26（六）、12/27（日）台北大巨蛋連開兩場**（生涯首次大巨蛋連場）；全巡 **11 城市 14 場、約 20 萬人**，香港不在名單內
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu's world tour, officially KENSHI YONEZU 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR / GHOST, covers 14 shows in 11 cities with about 200,000 attendees expected — up sharply from the 2025 JUNK tour's 7 cities and 10 sold-out shows. Taipei Dome on December 26-27 is the first two-night dome run of his career; Seoul follows on January 14, 16 and 17, 2027, then Singapore, Oakland, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Newark, Toronto, London, Paris and Amsterdam through February. Hong Kong is not included. The Japanese domestic leg runs from Nagano on November 6 to K-Arena Yokohama on December 17. The tour follows IRIS OUT, the Chainsaw Man – Reze Arc theme, which reached #5 on Billboard Global.

items.en: YOASOBI's 10-city Asia dome and stadium tour puts Taipei Dome on January 9-10, 2027
items.zh: **YOASOBI「SUPER PLANET」亞洲十城市大蛋／球場巡演：**台北大巨蛋 **2027/1/9（六）、1/10（日）**、新加坡國家體育場 **2027/2/20**；首爾、香港與另一海外城市待公布
items.summary: YOASOBI's ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027, announced at the close of their 2025 WANDARA hall tour, covers five Japanese cities (Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo, Tokyo) and five overseas, four of them named: Taipei, Seoul, Hong Kong and Singapore. The confirmed dates now circulating put Taipei Dome on January 9 and 10, 2027 and Singapore National Stadium on February 20, 2027, with Seoul, Hong Kong and one further city still TBA. For anyone tracking Taiwan dates this makes the next four months unusually dense: Fujii Kaze on October 31, Vaundy on October 31 and November 1, Kenshi Yonezu on December 26-27, then YOASOBI in the second week of January.
items.source: NiEW（YOASOBI 亞洲巡演公告）；CDJapan J-POP Goes Global 2026

items.en: Tracking-list status: 4 of 16 artists have confirmed Taiwan dates, all inside the next 12 weeks
items.zh: **清單 16 組歌手現況（本次 48h）**：確認台灣場次的有 **4 組 —— 藤井風（10/31 高雄）、Vaundy（10/31、11/1 台北）、米津玄師（12/26、12/27 大巨蛋）、YOASOBI（2027/1/9、10 大巨蛋）**；其餘 12 組本次無新消息
items.summary: Across the sixteen artists on the tracking list, four now have confirmed Taiwan dates and all fall within the next twelve weeks: Fujii Kaze in Kaohsiung on October 31, Vaundy at Taipei Arena on October 31 and November 1, Kenshi Yonezu at Taipei Dome on December 26-27, and YOASOBI at Taipei Dome on January 9-10, 2027. The remaining twelve — Yuuri, YUIKA, Ado, King Gnu, back number, LiSA, Official HIGE DANDISM, Aimer, tuki., RADWIMPS, Aimyon and Mrs. GREEN APPLE — produced no new Taiwan, Hong Kong or Japan dates in the past 48 hours. King Gnu (June), LiSA (June), back number (August), Official HIGE DANDISM (August) and tuki. (April) have already completed their 2026 Taipei runs.
items.source: 本專案追蹤清單（JPOP_追星歌手清單_標楷體版.docx，16 組）交叉 CDJapan、各官方公告

market.asOf: 台股＝**2026/10/16（五）13:30 收盤**；美股＝**2026/10/16（五）正規盤收盤**。　★★ **今天這一區最重要的一句話：今天（10/19，週一）是台股「回答」美股 10/16 那一跌的第一天。**台股 10/16 是收漲的（+0.30%），而美股同一天在台股收盤後 13 小時才收盤、且費半重跌 3.83%，所以這一跌台股至今**完全沒有反應過**。週末兩天無交易，以下數字與 10/18 簡報相同，但**解讀完全不同 —— 因為今天 09:00 開盤就是結算日**。
market.note: ★ **週一（10/19）開盤前只盯這三件，其他先放掉**：　**①開盤前 30 分鐘，記憶體四雄是「補跌」還是「不補跌」。**這是今天最具資訊量的訊號：美股記憶體整組跌 5.6–7.5%，而台股的 2408、2344、2337、6770 上週五是往上跑的。若開低後半小時內就把跌幅收到 2% 內，代表內資承接強；若跌幅擴大到 5% 以上，代表上週那波是熱錢而非基本面。　**②台積電（2330）的引導力。**10/16 台積電尾盤出現 **6,066 張大賣單、收跌 20 元**，外資也狠砍台積電，是指數漲而權值股不漲的「假強勢」。今天如果台積電補跌但指數扣得不多，反而是輪动行情；如果台積電帶頭跌且指數同步，就是真的補跌。　**③外資連 8 賣會不會變成連 9 賣。**三大法人 10/16 賣超 678.07 億、外資單日賣超 461 億，指數是被散戶和投信抬上去的。這種結構在美股重跌後的第一個交易日最脆弱。　★ **進階：週內還有一個非市場因子 —— 強颱薇琵。**若 10/22（四）發布陸上颱風警報、進而 10/23（五）停班停課，台股會「因颱風休市」—— 對持股者的影響是**一個不能調整的週末被拉長成三天**，而美股那幾天照常交易。若本週打算做短線，**請把「可能在週四就被迫持股到下週一」實際算進部位裡**。　★ **觀察清單命中率（清單共 75 檔：台股 29、美股 46）**：10/16 美股 ≥5% 名單裡有 **4 檔在清單內 —— AMD、Intel、Micron、Marvell**，全部是跌幅、全部隶屬「AI 半導體」與「半導體轉機」兩類。清單外最強烈的是 **CoreWeave（CRWV，-11.91%）**，已放在下方名單最上方。

indices.name: 加權指數 TAIEX
indices.note: 10/16（五）13:30 收盤 · **漲 141.39 點、+0.30%**，收 47,111.26，成交約 **9,359–9,379 億元（量縮）**。　★ 結構很重要：**三大法人賣超 678.07 億、外資賣超 461 億（連 8 賣）**，指數是散戶與投信抬回 47,000 點的；台積電尾盤有 6,066 張大賣單、**收跌 20 元**。盤中曾大漲逾 550 點、收盤只剩 141 點，是**尾盤被壓回來的 K**。　⚠️ 本次未能取得 10/16 的量能與法人數字之外的更細分項目（如融資餘額、未平倉）。新台幣 10/16 收 **32.3 元（走弱）**。

indices.note: ⚠️ **本次執行未能取得 0050、0056 在 2026/10/16 的確認收盤價與漲跌幅**（公開查詢未回傳精確日資料），所以這一行**不填數字、不推估**，請直接看下單平台。　★ 可用的替代推論：0050 跟蹤台灣 50 指數，成分股以台積電最重（權重約四成以上），而 **10/16 台積電是收跌的（-20 元）**，因此 0050 的表現很可能**弱於加權指數的 +0.30%**。這是推論，不是數據。

indices.note: ⚠️ 同上，**10/16 確認收盤數字本次未取得，不填、不推估**。　★ 結構上 0056 是高股息型，成分股更偏重金融、電信與傳統產業，對美股 AI／半導體重跌的敏感度**明顯低於 0050**。若今天台股真的補跌，0056 通常是清單裡最抗跌的一端；這也是推論，不是數據。

indices.note: 10/16（五）收 11,137.29、**-3.83%**，而且 **30 檔成分股全數下跌**。　★★ **這是今天對台股最直接相關的單一數字。**台股的觀察清單裡有 29 檔台股，其中絕大多數（台積電、聯發科、日月光、南亞科、華邦電、旺宏、力積電、世苯、創意）與費半成分股高度連動。

indices.note: 10/16（五）收盤約 709.80、**-2.5%**，與那斯達克 100 同步。　⚠️ 此數字沒有取得本次執行的第二來源交叉確認，與 10/18 簡報相同，請以下單平台為準。

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚今天這一區的資料基準
movers.price: 今天（2026/10/19，週一）09:00 前尚未開盤；以下全部是 2026/10/16（五）的收盤／盤中資料
movers.reason: ★ **週末兩天無交易，所以没有「昨日」的 ≥5% 名單可列，以下沿用 10/16 最後一個交易日。**但與 10/18 簡報不同的是：**今天這份名單是「即將被市場清算」的清單**，不是歷史紀錄 —— 因為台股 09:00 就要針對它們反應。美股部分為 10/16 正規盤收盤漲跌幅（已確認）；台股部分為 10/16 **盤中（約 11:21）**熱門焦點股，**非收盤值**，已逐檔標註。

movers.reason: **全市場 10/16 跌幅最大的大型 AI 標的，単日 -11.91%。**CoreWeave 是「AI 算力租賃」純正標的（GPU cloud），因此它的跌幅是市場對**AI 資本支出可持續性**的最靈敏測量計。　★ **為何與你有關**：它和你清單裡的台股 AI 似服器組（緯創 3231、緯穎 6669、英業達 2356、廣達 2382）是同一條需求錡的上下游，清單里卻沒有任何一檔「AI 算力租賃」純正標的 —— 建議把 CRWV 加進「雲端資料」或新增「AI 算力」分類做先行指標。　⚠️ 注意：此類標的波動極高（本小節非買賣建議）。

movers.name: AMD（✅ 在觀察清單內·美股·AI 半導體）
